newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt expects car tariff report soon.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt expects car tariff report soon.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Tuesday a key government industry body was expected to soon complete its report on the automotive industry.
"I expect the final report of the Productivity Commission will be received by the government quite shortly -- the exact day, I don't know," Howard told parliament.
The commission, in its draft report, recommended car tariffs be cut to five percent by 2004. Tariffs are currently scheduled to be fall from 22.5 percent to 15 percent by 2000.
The car industry has expressed concern about the commission's recommendations, but the government has not yet indicated its response.
Howard told parliament the government would respond speedily after the final report was handed to the government.
